ingredients.notes: Sivulla kuusi kananmunaa näytetään kappaleina. Ravintoarvion 55 g/munan syötävä paino on Fineli 8513:n laskennallinen vastine. Muut ainekset punnitaan.

method.notes: Six medium eggs at the Fineli 8513 edible portion of 55 g each give a 330 g reference batch for the estimate; the actual peeled weight varies. Use all six eggs for twelve filled halves. Use commercial full-fat mayonnaise and prepared mustard rather than brand-specific products whose fibre or polyol values are unavailable. The seasoning uses fresh chives. No physical preparation trial was performed.

food_safety.notes: Both white and yolk are cooked until firm. Cool under cold water, chill the prepared portions promptly and store in the refrigerator.

servings_and_time.notes: 6 portions with 35 minutes including the specified cooking and resting or cooling periods.
